title.en: Warmth and dedication of the kennel team

text.en: Reviewers consistently describe the staff as warm, caring and genuinely devoted to the animals in their care. One owner notes that their dog has returned happily for fourteen years and is treated like family. Another highlights friendly, communicative handlers, and a third mentions Irene by name as someone dogs eagerly respond to.

title.en: Dogs' wellbeing and enjoyment during stays

text.en: All three reviewers comment on the positive impact boarding has on their dogs. Pets are described as visibly happy and tired out after their stay, and one long-term client notes their dog becomes excited at the prospect of going back. The overall impression is that animals are well exercised and content throughout their time at the kennels.

Clients find the drop-off and pick-up process straightforward and pleasant. One reviewer specifically praises easy handover logistics and good communication, while another describes the transition from arrival to departure as smooth and reassuring for owners.

q.en: Are dogs happy at Ballygarvan Kennels & Grooming?

a.en: Reviewers consistently report that their dogs are content and enthusiastic about visits, with one client returning for fourteen years.

q.en: How is the drop-off and pick-up process?

a.en: Clients describe it as easy and well organised, with clear communication from staff throughout.

q.en: Is the kennel suitable for long-term boarding clients?

a.en: Yes — at least one reviewer has been bringing their dog there for fourteen years, indicating consistent satisfaction over an extended period.
